- Real Estate - Watch the fresh **RS cross** trigger; confirm if relative strength continues to expand positively against SPY, whereas an immediate reversal back below the zero line invalidates the early rotation.
- Basic Materials - Track the **RS new high** trigger; confirmed by relative strength holding or extending its 20-session high versus SPY, while a sharp pullback beneath the prior relative breakout level invalidates leadership.
- Consumer Cyclical - Monitor the **RS new high** trigger; confirmed by sustaining leadership above the 20-session relative high, while failure to hold these relative gains invalidates the breakout.
- Consumer Defensive - Observe the **RS new high** trigger; confirmation comes from continued relative strength expansion at 20-session highs, while relative underperformance that drops RS back into its recent range invalidates the signal.
